title: Train Station
content: Have you all ever been to a train station in Mall World that looks similar to this? I've been there a few times but have never been able to get onto a train. There's an indoor waiting area that connects to the rest of the mall, but whenever you walk out of it to step onto the platform, there are never any trains stopped for boarding. https://preview.redd.it/i63czqg5s29g1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=2d90113410b6d3c0fb45b6f207d7acab066e3666
